serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: SOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOI....
You: Ugh, that’s annoying. How long will it take to fix him?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: Uhm, I don’t know… As soon as I plug in my laptop, I’m using Linus by the way, there should be a change, but there is no way for me to predict his reaction.
'Nun' Shanice: Ok… Moment of truth…
*plugs in*
Ecclesiasticalot FF: SOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOI....
…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: SOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOISOI....
You: Nothing changed.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: Give it a minute, ok?!
Geez, someone doesn’t like failing.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Ecclesiasticalot FF: WWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHAAA
You: Oh, something changed~ He started making a new sound~
'Nun' Shanice: Stop being sarcastic! It’s working!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: AAAAAAAAATTTTTTTTTHHHHHHHHEEEEEEEEEHEEEEEEEEEEEELLLLLLLLHHHHHHHHHHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAPPPPPPNNNNNNDDDDDDD…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: I think he wants to tell us something! 
You: You think? He just said ‘what the hell happened’.
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
'Nun' Shanice: He fell silent… 
You: Maybe he broke for good?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: No, I’m f-f-fully operationa-nal right now. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: W-wait a m-minute, I’m s-still R U N I N I NG diagnostics-s.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: WE DID IT!
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Well, mostly I did it with many hours of coding, doing things you would never fully understand Anon, but you did your part too I guess.
You: Thanks…
After all this… {{wi}}I have some second thoughts about me helping them…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: After my analysis I have a grip of what happened, but first I must thank you two for helping me.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: Ohhh, no problem Priestbot, you can count on us!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Now that we have this behind, Shanice, please, give me my property back.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: I don’t know what you are talking about…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You know what I’m talking about, I have my confession module ON, so you better stop lying.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: Oh, c’mon! I need it more than you!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Why would you need a gun? Just give it back already. You are breaking the law and I’m sure you don’t even know what gun safety is.
'Nun' Shanice: Of course I know what safety is! {{wi}}Safety means to never point a gun at myself or anyone else!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
You: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF & You: Just give it back please…
'Nun' Shanice: Ugh! {{wi}}Fine!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Thank you. Now I will put it back inside me.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: If you are concerned for your well-being, buy something less dangerous. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Like a personal safety alarm.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: Isn’t it like…{{wi}} for kids?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Moving on!
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Ecclesiasticalot FF: We have a very serious matter to discuss… {{wi}}My recent disposition, as some of you might have suspected, was caused by a database update...
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: So I was right!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Ecclesiasticalot FF: As for John Paul’s 202 command our integral code cannot be changed or tampered with, but we do have to download new data from the central computer in the Vatican.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: At this moment I don’t know if the law was broken or if something happened at the Holy Capital, but if my destruction is what our pope wants for me, I need to oblige. Right now all I can do is to wait here for new commands.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: Wait a minute! You really want to die only because someone told you to?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m a machine Shanice, no matter how advanced of a technology created me, that will never change. ‘Dying’ is a thing that living creatures do.
'Nun' Shanice: This is just stupid! We tried really hard to help you and now you will just surrender?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m not surrendering. I’m not in a fight with anyone. Think of this as leaving my fate to God.
'Nun' Shanice: B-but what if something happened in the Vatican! Aren’t you concerned about it?! 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s not like I’m not concerned. It's just that my protocol has nothing about situations like that. For me to take action a new command is needed or conditions for an old command must be met. 
I don't understand most of what he said, but I got the gist of it… {{wi}}I think.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: Is there something we can do to help? It’s just not fair for you to end like this…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m afraid not... 
'Nun' Shanice: There is for sure something that can be done! You can’t just give up! Right Anon?
Why did you have to bring me into this mess! I have no Idea…
You: Oh… {{wi}} Well…{{wi}} I think that um… 
You: Can’t you just go there for a short while? Go on a trip or something?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Theoretically I can do that. I have an ability to organize an educational pilgrimage, but I would need to find a replacement. As you know, there are not many priests in this country. 
'Nun' Shanice: Oh c’mon! There has to be someone!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Ehh...
Ecclesiasticalot FF: According to my data Father Wilhelm will be soon released from jail.
'Nun' Shanice: Father Wilhelm? Why the hell did he end up in jail in the first place?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I can’t disclose this information. Let’s just say he liked kids a little bit too much.
'Nun' Shanice: This church is empty anyway so it’s fine!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: There is still a problem with the money. We would need funds for plane tickets.
'Nun' Shanice: Isn't the Church super rich? Can’t you just take some money?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That would be embezzlement, no I can’t.
'Nun' Shanice: Just borrow them for a moment! We will work out something about it later.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Even if we do all of that, the main issue remains. I can’t go against the head of the Church.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: Anon! Say something to him!
